taxon.note: Scientific and common names (and USDA symbol, where given) as the spec's authors wrote them, and the genus the scientific name is written in.

growth_form.note: The growth form the spec's authors chose from the plant's habit: a shrub, sometimes arborescent (Flora of North America vol. 12).

growth.note: The growth plan (years, step, keyframes) chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

variants.note: The environments, conditions and seeds chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

taxon.family.note: WCVP v16's family for the accepted name.

taxon.plant_name_id.note: WCVP v16's plant_name_id for the accepted species the name resolves to (the accepted name).

traits.height_max_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 12 (2016), Ceanothus thyrsiflorus (read on eFloras, 2026-10-18): "Shrubs, sometimes arborescent, evergreen, 0.5-6 m." The rare top of 8 m is the model estimate's greatest height (species-facts-2026-10-15, confidence high, record L2706903).

traits.leaf_length_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 12 (2016), Ceanothus thyrsiflorus (read on eFloras, 2026-10-18): "blade flat to cupped, elliptic to ovate, 10-40(-50) x 5-15(-20) mm".

traits.leaf_width_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 12 (2016), Ceanothus thyrsiflorus (read on eFloras, 2026-10-18): blade "10-40(-50) x 5-15(-20) mm".

traits.petiole_length_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 12 (2016), Ceanothus thyrsiflorus (read on eFloras, 2026-10-18): "petiole 3-10 mm".

traits.leaf_habit.note: Flora of North America vol. 12 (2016), Ceanothus thyrsiflorus (read on eFloras, 2026-10-18): "Shrubs, sometimes arborescent, evergreen".

traits.leaf_arrangement.note: A model estimate (confidence high, record L2706903), as no source read gives it.

traits.inflorescence.note: Flora of North America vol. 12 (2016), Ceanothus thyrsiflorus (read on eFloras, 2026-10-18): "Inflorescences terminal, usually racemelike, rarely paniclelike".

traits.inflorescence_length_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 12 (2016), Ceanothus thyrsiflorus (read on eFloras, 2026-10-18): inflorescences "2.5-9 cm". Idžojtić, Dendrology (2019), Ceanothus thyrsiflorus (dendrology-2026-10-14#931): 3.5-7.5 cm, inside it.

traits.flowering_position.note: Flora of North America vol. 12 (2016), Ceanothus thyrsiflorus (read on eFloras, 2026-10-18): "Inflorescences terminal".

traits.flower_colour.note: Flora of North America vol. 12 (2016), Ceanothus thyrsiflorus (read on eFloras, 2026-10-18): "sepals, petals, and nectary usually pale to deep blue, rarely white"; Dendrology (dendrology-2026-10-14#931): pale to dark blue, rarely near white. The colour is our reading of the words, a middle blue.

traits.flower_size_m.note: A model estimate (confidence high, record L2706903), as no source read gives it.

traits.fruit_type.note: Flora of North America vol. 12 (2016), Ceanothus thyrsiflorus (read on eFloras, 2026-10-18): "Capsules 3-4 mm wide, weakly lobed".

traits.fruit_size_m.note: Idžojtić, Dendrology (2019), Ceanothus thyrsiflorus (dendrology-2026-10-14#931): fruit 2.5-4 mm.

traits.fruit_width_m.note: Flora of North America vol. 12 (2016), Ceanothus thyrsiflorus (read on eFloras, 2026-10-18): "Capsules 3-4 mm wide".

traits.fruit_colour_ripe.note: Idžojtić, Dendrology (2019), Ceanothus thyrsiflorus (dendrology-2026-10-14#931): fruit black when ripe. The colour is our reading of the word.

traits.fruit_armature.note: Flora of North America vol. 12 (2016), Ceanothus thyrsiflorus (read on eFloras, 2026-10-18): "valves smooth, viscid, not crested".

traits.flowering_months.note: Flora of North America vol. 12 (2016), Ceanothus thyrsiflorus (read on eFloras, 2026-10-18): "Flowering Mar-Jun." Dendrology (dendrology-2026-10-14#931): March-June (July).

traits.fruiting_months.note: A model estimate (confidence high, record L2706903), as no source read gives it.

generator.params.note: Snowbrush ceanothus's values, changed for blueblossom: fewer stems from the base and slightly longer internodes for a taller shrub, sometimes arborescent (FNA vol. 12: 0.5-6 m); crown_radius, path_half, leaf_size, spur_leaf and bloom_size left to the rules from the traits (height, leaf and petiole length, inflorescence length); leaf_years 2 for an evergreen. Not fitted to measurements.

allometry.note: 2.5 m at 12 years in the open, within FNA's 0.5-6 m. Replace with measured data before calling this species calibrated.

appearance.note: After FNA vol. 12 and Dendrology: the flowers' colour is the trait's "pale to deep blue" as linear light, the accent a paler blue for the blue nectary and stamens; the capsule's colour is Dendrology's "black"; the leaf card's outline, petiole, teeth and veins are left to the rules from the traits. Bark brown by eye, as snowbrush's. Foliage colour comes from leaf_colour by the rule. The cluster's fruit share (inflorescence size 0.06) is the fruit's 2.5 to 4 mm (Dendrology) over the cluster drawn about 6 cm long, as the fruit-unit rule works it for an organ named fruit, which a broadleaf bloom is not.

traits.leaf_colour.note: Flora of North America vol. 12 (2016), Ceanothus thyrsiflorus (read on eFloras, 2026-10-18): "adaxial surface dark green, glabrate". The colour is our reading of the words.
